## Summary

Describe the CanvasEngine behavior this changes and why it belongs in rpgjs-patches.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm verify`
- [ ] The defect is reproduced by a test against the real CanvasEngine classes, and the test fails without the change
- [ ] Every release in the compatibility matrix still passes
- [ ] Public API or behavior changes are reflected in README and `docs/`
- [ ] Breaking changes use a Conventional Commit `!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer

## Compatibility

List behavior changes, the CanvasEngine releases affected, or write “No compatibility impact.”
